whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Samsara Restaurant,

I noticed your restaurant has amazing 4.7★ reviews from over 800 happy diners in Patliputra Colony, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table reservations and menu exploration.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct table reservation, digital menu, aur location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/samsara

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi Team Samsara Restaurant, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with a digital menu, direct table reservation, and mobile-first speed for Patliputra Colony diners. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
